title: Giphy
content:
## Overview

Giphy is a popular GIF search and sharing platform that lets you integrate animated GIFs into your applications. The Giphy integration in Emergent allows your app to search, display, and embed GIFs from Giphy's extensive library.

This guide walks you through setting up the Giphy integration for your Emergent project.

## Prerequisites

Before you begin, you'll need:

- An Emergent project (web or mobile)
- A Giphy account (free or paid)
- A Giphy API key from the [Giphy Developers Portal](https://developers.giphy.com/)

<Note>
Giphy offers a free tier with rate limits suitable for development and small-scale applications. Check the Giphy Developers Portal for current usage limits and pricing.
</Note>

## Getting your Giphy API key

<Steps>
<Step title="Create a Giphy account">
Visit [developers.giphy.com](https://developers.giphy.com/) and sign up for a free account if you don't already have one.
</Step>

<Step title="Create an app in the Giphy Dashboard">
Once logged in, navigate to the **Dashboard** and click **Create an App**. Choose the type of app you're building:

- **API** for standard integration
- **SDK** if you plan to use Giphy's native SDKs

Provide a name and description for your app.
</Step>

<Step title="Copy your API key">
After creating the app, Giphy will generate an **API Key** for you. Copy this key — you'll need it in the next section.
</Step>
</Steps>

## Adding Giphy to your Emergent project

<Steps>
<Step title="Open your project settings">
In the Emergent chat interface, tell the AI you want to add Giphy integration. For example:

```
Add Giphy integration so users can search and insert GIFs
```

The AI agents will guide you through the setup process.
</Step>

<Step title="Provide your API key">
When prompted, paste your Giphy API key. The platform will securely store it as an environment variable in your project.

<Warning>
Never commit API keys directly in your code. Emergent automatically handles secure storage of credentials.
</Warning>
</Step>

<Step title="Describe your GIF search requirements">
Tell the AI how you want to use Giphy in your app. For example:

- "Add a GIF search button in the message composer"
- "Show trending GIFs on the home page"
- "Let users search and preview GIFs before sending"

The AI will implement the appropriate UI and API calls.
</Step>

<Step title="Test the integration">
Once the AI has implemented the Giphy features, test the GIF search and display functionality in your app preview. Try searching for different terms and verify that GIFs load correctly.
</Step>
</Steps>

## Common use cases

<CardGroup cols={2}>
<Card title="Chat applications" icon="message-circle">
Add GIF search to message composers, allowing users to search and send animated reactions.
</Card>

<Card title="Social feeds" icon="users">
Display trending or curated GIFs in social media feeds and content discovery interfaces.
</Card>

<Card title="Marketing content" icon="megaphone">
Embed GIFs in marketing emails, landing pages, or promotional content.
</Card>

<Card title="User profiles" icon="user">
Let users select animated avatars or profile decorations from Giphy's library.
</Card>
</CardGroup>

## API endpoints and features

The Giphy API provides several endpoints you can reference when describing features to the AI:

| Endpoint | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `/search` | Search GIFs by keyword or phrase |
| `/trending` | Fetch currently trending GIFs |
| `/translate` | Convert text into a relevant GIF |
| `/random` | Get a random GIF, optionally filtered by tag |
| `/gifs` | Fetch GIF details by ID |

<Tip>
You don't need to know the API details — just describe what you want in natural language, and the AI will implement the correct endpoints.
</Tip>

## Rate limits and best practices

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="What are the rate limits?">
Giphy's free tier includes rate limits on API requests. The exact limits depend on your account type and are subject to change. Check the [Giphy Developers Portal](https://developers.giphy.com/) for current limits.

For production apps with high traffic, consider upgrading to a paid Giphy plan.
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="How should I handle attribution?">
Giphy's terms of service require attribution when displaying GIFs. The AI will typically include the Giphy logo or "Powered by Giphy" text automatically. Make sure this attribution remains visible in your final design.
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="Can I cache GIF results?">
Giphy's terms allow temporary caching to improve performance, but you must not store GIFs permanently or create a competing GIF library. The AI-generated code will handle caching appropriately.
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="What content rating should I use?">
Giphy GIFs are rated `g` (general audiences), `pg`, `pg-13`, and `r`. By default, searches exclude `r`-rated content. You can specify rating filters when describing your requirements to the AI.
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

## Troubleshooting

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="GIFs aren't loading">
- Verify your API key is correct in the project environment variables
- Check your network connection and firewall settings
- Ensure you haven't exceeded your rate limit (check the Giphy Dashboard for usage stats)
- Try a different search term — some queries may return no results
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="Attribution logo is missing">
Tell the AI to add Giphy attribution:

```
Make sure the Giphy logo appears when GIFs are displayed
```

The AI will add the required attribution UI element.
</Accordion>

<Accordion title="Search results are inappropriate">
Specify content rating filters when describing your feature:

```
Add GIF search with G and PG ratings only, exclude mature content
```

The AI will configure the rating parameter in API calls.
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

## Next steps

Once your Giphy integration is working:

- Customize the GIF picker UI to match your app's design
- Add favorites or recent GIF functionality for returning users
- Implement GIF preview before sending in chat applications
- Explore Giphy Stickers API for static or animated sticker content

<Info>
Need help with your Giphy integration? Describe any issues or customizations you need in the Emergent chat, and the AI agents will assist you.
</Info>
